title: San Diego VR
specs: Immersive VR Escape Rooms with puzzles and challenges
Zero Latency VR with massive free-roam arena and ultra-realistic gameplay
Multiplayer VR battles and team-based challenges
Ages 8 and up for Battle Start VR Party Mode
Ages 10 and up for MVP packages and Escape Rooms
Ages 12 and up for Battle Start VR Tactics Mode
Players age 10 to 12 must be accompanied by an adult
Guests must be able to physically walk around for an hour unassisted and use both hands the whole time
No alcohol or drugs before or during session
Event room available for $50 with minimum 6 players required to reserve
